heading.en: Jesus provides bread and wine miraculously and again administers the sacrament unto the people—The remnant of Jacob will come to the knowledge of the Lord their God and will inherit the Americas—Jesus is the prophet like unto Moses, and the Nephites are children of the prophets—Others of the Lord's people will be gathered to Jerusalem. About A.D. 34.
heading.sm: Ua saunia e Iesu le areto ma le uaina i se ala faavavega ma ua toe faamanuia ma tufatufa atu le faamanatuga i tagata—O le a aumai le vaega o totoe o Iakopo i le malamalama o le Alii lo latou Atua, ma o le a fai mo o latou tofi le laueleele o Amerika—O Iesu o le perofeta e pei o Mose, ma o tagata sa Nifaē o fanau a perofeta—O isi o tagata o le Alii o le a faapotopotoina i Ierusalema. E tusa o le 34 T.A.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he commanded the multitude that they should cease to pray, and also his disciples. And he commanded them that they should not cease to pray in their hearts.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina poloai atu o ia i le motu o tagata ma ona soo foi e ao ina o latou tuu le latou tatalo. Ma sa ia poloai atu ia te i latou ia latou le tuu le tatalo i o latou loto.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And he commanded them that they should arise and stand up upon their feet. And they arose up and stood upon their feet.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia poloaiina i latou ia latou tutulai ma tutu i luga i o latou vae. Ma sa latou tutulai ma tutu i luga i o latou vae.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he brake bread again and blessed it, and gave to the disciples to eat.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina toe tofitofi e ia le areto ma faamanuia i ai, ma avatu i le au soo e aai ai.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And when they had eaten he commanded them that they should break bread, and give unto the multitude.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou aai, sa ia poloaiina i latou ia latou tofitofi le areto, ma avatu i le motu o tagata.

verses.en: And when they had given unto the multitude he also gave them wine to drink, and commanded them that they should give unto the multitude.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou avatu i le motu o tagata sa ia avatu foi ia te i latou le uaina e feinu ai, ma poloaiina i latou e tatau ona latou avatu i le motu o tagata.

w.en: And when they had given it

verses.en: Now, there had been no bread, neither wine, brought by the disciples, neither by the multitude;
verses.sm: O lenei, sa leai se areto, po o se uaina, na aumai e le au soo, po o le motu o tagata;

verses.en: But he truly gave unto them bread to eat, and also wine to drink.
verses.sm: Ae sa ia avatu moni lava ia te i latou le areto e aai ai, ma le uaina foi e feinu ai.

verses.en: And he said unto them: He that eateth this bread eateth of my body to his soul; and he that drinketh of this wine drinketh of my blood to his soul; and his soul shall never hunger nor thirst, but shall be filled.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia fetalai atu ia te i latou: O ia o lē e ’ai i lenei areto ua’ai o ia i lo’u tino mo lona agaga; o ia o lē e inu i lenei uaina ua inu o ia i lo’u toto mo lona agaga; ma o le a le fia ’ai lava pe fia inu lona agaga, ae o le a faatumuina.

w.en: and his soul shall never hunger

verses.en: Now, when the multitude had all eaten and drunk, behold, they were filled with the Spirit; and they did cry out with one voice, and gave glory to Jesus, whom they both saw and heard.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina ua uma ona aai ma feinu le motu uma o tagata, faauta, sa faatumulia i latou i le Agaga; ma sa latou alalaga faatasi i le leo e tasi, ma avatu le viiga ia Iesu, o lē na latou vaai ma faalogo i ai.

w.en: and they did cry out together

verses.en: And it came to pass that when they had all given glory unto Jesus, he said unto them: Behold now I finish the commandment which the Father hath commanded me concerning this people, who are a remnant of the house of Israel.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona avatu e i latou uma o le viiga ia Iesu, na ia fetalai mai ia te i latou: Faauta o lenei ua uma ona ou faia o le poloaiga lea na poloaiina ai a’u e le Tamā e faatatau i lenei nuu, o ē o se vaega o totoe o le aiga o Isaraelu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Ye remember that I spake unto you, and said that when the words of Isaiah should be fulfilled—behold they are written, ye have them before you, therefore search them—
verses.sm: Tou te manatua na ou tautala atu ia te outou, ma fai atu, pe a faataunuuina upu a Isaia— faauta ua tusia i latou, ua i ai i latou i o outou luma, o lea ia outou suesue i ai—

verses.en: And verily, verily, I say unto you, that when they shall be fulfilled then is the fulfilling of the covenant which the Father hath made unto his people, O house of Israel.
verses.sm: Ma e moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, pe a faataunuuina i latou o le faataunuuina lava o le feagaiga lea na faia e le Tamā i lona nuu, o le aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And then shall the remnants, which shall be scattered abroad upon the face of the earth, be gathered in from the east and from the west, and from the south and from the north; and they shall be brought to the knowledge of the Lord their God, who hath redeemed them.
verses.sm: Ma o le taimi lena o le a faapotopoto mai ai vaega o totoe, ia o le a faataapeapeina solo i luga o le fogaeleele, mai sasae ma mai sisifo, ma mai saute ma mai matu; ma o le a aumaia i latou i le malamalama o le Alii lo latou Atua, o lē ua togiolaina i latou.

w.en: upon the face of the earth,

verses.en: And the Father hath commanded me that I should give unto you this land, for your inheritance.
verses.sm: Ma ua poloaiina a’u e le Tamā ia ou tuu atu ia te outou lenei laueleele, mo lo outou tofi.

verses.en: And I say unto you, that if the Gentiles do not repent after the blessing which they shall receive, after they have scattered my people—
verses.sm: Ma ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e le salamo Nuuese pe a mavae le faamanuiaga lea o le a latou maua, pe a mavae ona latou faataapeapeina o ou tagata—

verses.en: Then shall ye, who are a remnant of the house of Jacob, go forth among them; and ye shall be in the midst of them who shall be many; and ye shall be among them as a lion among the beasts of the forest, and as a young lion among the flocks of sheep, who, if he goeth through both treadeth down and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o outou, o ē o se vaega o totoe o le aiga o Iakopo, i totonu ia te i latou; ma o le a outou i ai i le totonugalemu o i latou o ē o le a toatele; ma o le a outou i ai i totonu ia te i latou e pei o se leona i totonu o manu o le vao, ma e pei o se leona taanoa i totonu o lafu o mamoe, o lē, afai e ui atu ai o ia o le a ia solia i lalo i latou ma saeia ninii, ma e leai se e mafai ona laveaiina.

verses.en: Thy hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
verses.sm: O le a siitia a’e lo’u lima i luga o ou fili, ma o le a vavae ese ou fili uma.

verses.en: And I will gather my people together as a man gathereth his sheaves into the floor.
verses.sm: Ma o le a ou faapotopoto faatasi o’u tagata e pei ona faapotopoto faatasi e se tagata ana fusi saito i luga o le fola.

verses.en: For I will make my people with whom the Father hath covenanted, yea, I will make thy horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass. And thou shalt beat in pieces many people; and I will consecrate their gain unto the Lord, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth. And behold, I am he who doeth it.
verses.sm: Ona o le a ou faia o’u tagata o ē na osifeagaiga ai le Tamā, ioe, o le a ou faia ou seu ma uamea, ma o le a ou faia ou atigivae ma apamemea. Ma o le a e tuimomomoina tagata e toatele; ma o le a ou faapaiaina a latou vete mo le Alii, ma a latou mea mo le Alii o le lalolagi atoa. Faauta foi, o a’u lava o lē e faia ia mea.

w.en: And thou shalt beat in pieces

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, saith the Father, that the sword of my justice shall hang over them at that day; and except they repent it shall fall upon them, saith the Father, yea, even upon all the nations of the Gentiles.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, ua fetalai mai ai le Tamā, o le a tautau ifo i luga o i latou le pelu o lo’u faamasinotonu i lena aso; ma e vagana ai ua latou salamo o le a pa’ū ifo i luga o i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le Tamā, ioe, i luga lava o atunuu uma o Nuuese.

w.en: And it shall come to pass,

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that I will establish my people, O house of Israel.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo ina o le a ou faatumauina o’u tagata, o le aiga o Isaraelu.

w.en: And it shall come to pass that

verses.en: And behold, this people will I establish in this land, unto the fulfilling of the covenant which I made with your father Jacob; and it shall be a New Jerusalem. And the powers of heaven shall be in the midst of this people; yea, even I will be in the midst of you.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o le a ou faatumauina lenei nuu i lenei laueleele, e faataunuu ai le feagaiga na ou faia ma lo outou tamā o Iakopo; ma o le a avea ma se Ierusalema Fou. Ma o le a i ai i totonu o lenei nuu mana o le lagi; ioe, o le a Ou i ai i le lotolotoi o outou.

verses.en: Behold, I am he of whom Moses spake, saying: A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you. And it shall come to pass that every soul who will not hear that prophet shall be cut off from among the people.
verses.sm: Faauta, o a’u o lē na fetalai i ai Mose, ua faapea mai: O le a faatulai a’e e le Alii le Atua se perofeta ia te outou mai o outou uso, e pei o a’u; ia outou faalogo ia te ia i soo se mea na te fai atu ai ia te outou. Ma o le a oo foi ina vavae ese mai totonu o le nuu soo se tasi o le a le faalogo i lena perofeta.

w.en: And it shall come to pass that

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have testified of me.
verses.sm: E moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, ioe, ma o perofeta uma mai ia Samuelu ma i latou o e na mulimuli mai, o le toatele o e na fetalai, na molimau uma ia te au.

verses.en: And behold, ye are the children of the prophets; and ye are of the house of Israel; and ye are of the covenant which the Father made with your fathers, saying unto Abraham: And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o outou o fanau a perofeta; ma o outou o lo le aiga o Isaraelu; ma o outou o lo le feagaiga lea na faia e le Tama ma o outou tamā, na fetalai atu ai ia Aperaamo: Ma o lau fanau o le a manuia ai aiga uma o le lalolagi.

verses.en: The Father having raised me up unto you first, and sent me to bless you in turning away every one of you from his iniquities; and this because ye are the children of the covenant—
verses.sm: Ua faatuina a’e a’u e le Tamā e muamua ia te outou, ma auina mai a’u e faamanuia ia te outou i le liliu ese o outou taitoatasi mai i ana amioletonu; ma o le pogai ona o outou o fanau o le feagaiga—

verses.en: And after that ye were blessed then fulfilleth the Father the covenant which he made with Abraham, saying: In thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed—unto the pouring out of the Holy Ghost through me upon the Gentiles, which blessing upon the Gentiles shall make them mighty above all, unto the scattering of my people, O house of Israel.
verses.sm: Ma pe a uma ona faamanuiaina o outou ona faataunuu ai lea e le Tamā le feagaiga lea na ia faia ma Aperaamo, fai mai: O lau fanau o le a manuia ai aiga uma o le lalolagi— i le liligi mai o le Agaga Paia e ala mai ia te a’u i luga o Nuuese, o se faamanuiaga lea i luga o Nuuese o le a faia ai i latou ia sili atu ona latou malolosi i luga o tagata uma, e oo i le faataapeapeina o lo’u nuu, o le aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And they shall be a scourge unto the people of this land. Nevertheless, when they shall have received the fulness of my gospel, then if they shall harden their hearts against me I will return their iniquities upon their own heads, saith the Father.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea i latou o se sasa i tagata o lenei laueleele. Ae ui i lea, pe a uma ona latou maua o le atoatoaga o la’u talalelei, ma afai latou te faamaaa o latou loto faasaga mai ia te a’u o le a ou faafoi atu a latou amioletonu i luga o o latou lava ulu, ua fetalai mai ai le Tamā.

verses.en: And I will remember the covenant which I have made with my people; and I have covenanted with them that I would gather them together in mine own due time, that I would give unto them again the land of their fathers for their inheritance, which is the land of Jerusalem, which is the promised land unto them forever, saith the Father.
verses.sm: Ma o le a ou manatua le feagaiga lea na ou faia ma lo’u nuu; ma sa ou osifeagaiga ma i latou o le a ou faapotopotoina faatasi i latou i lo’u lava taimi, ma o le a ou toe tuu atu ia te i latou le laueleele o o latou tamā mo lo latou tofi, o le laueleele lea o Ierusalema, o le laueleele lea na folafola atu mo i latou e faavavau, ua fetalai mai ai le Tama.

w.en: and that I would give again

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that the time cometh, when the fulness of my gospel shall be preached unto them;
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo foi ina oo mai le taimi o le a tala’i atu ai le atoatoaga o la’u talalelei ia te i latou;

w.en: And it shall come to pass that

verses.en: And they shall believe in me, that I am Jesus Christ, the Son of God, and shall pray unto the Father in my name.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou talitonu ia te a’u, o a’u o Iesu Keriso, o le Atalii o le Atua, ma o le a latou tatalo atu i le Tamā i lo’u igoa.

verses.en: Then shall their watchmen lift up their voice, and with the voice together shall they sing; for they shall see eye to eye.
verses.sm: Ona siisii ae lea i luga e o latou tagata-leoleo o o latou leo, ma o le a latou pepese faatasi; ona o le a latou fevaaia’i i latou lava.

verses.en: Then will the Father gather them together again, and give unto them Jerusalem for the land of their inheritance.
verses.sm: Ona toe faapotopoto ai lea o i latou e le Tamā, ma tuu atu ia te i latou Ierusalema mo le laueleele o lo latou tofi.

verses.en: Then shall they break forth into joy—Sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem; for the Father hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ona latou alalaga lea i le olioli— Ia pepese faatasi, outou nofoaga tuufua o Ierusalema; ona ua faamafanafanaina e le Tamā ona tagata, ua ia togiolaina Ierusalema.

verses.en: The Father hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of the Father; and the Father and I are one.
verses.sm: Ua afe e le Tamā lona aao paia i luma o mata o atunuu uma; ma o le a vaai tuluiga uma o le lalolagi i le faaolataga a le Tamā; ma o le Tamā ma a’u ua tasi.

verses.en: And then shall be brought to pass that which is written: Awake, awake again, and put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city, for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.sm: Ma ona faataunuu ai lea o lena mea ua tusia: Ala mai ia, ina toe ala mai ia; ma ofu lou malosi, Siona e; ia ofu ou ofu matagofie, Ierusalema e, le aai paia, ona o le a amata atu nei ma le agai i luma ona le toe sau ia te oe se ua le peritomeina ma ua le mamā.

w.en: And then shall be brought to pass

verses.en: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, sit down, O Jerusalem; loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.sm: Lūlū oe lava mai le efuefu; tulai, alaala i lalo, Ierusalema e; tatala oe lava mai noataga o lou ua, le afafine e faatagataotaua o Siona.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord: Ye have sold yourselves for naught, and ye shall be redeemed without money.
verses.sm: Ona ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii: Ua outou faatau atu outou lava mo le meanoa; ma o le a togiolaina outou e aunoa ma ni tupe.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that my people shall know my name; yea, in that day they shall know that I am he that doth speak.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a iloa e o’u tagata lo’u igoa; ioe, o le a latou iloa i lena aso o a’u lava o ia o lē o loo tautala atu.

verses.en: And then shall they say: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings unto them, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings unto them of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion: Thy God reigneth!
verses.sm: Ma ona latou fai mai ai ai lea: Ua maeu lava le matagofie i luga o mauga o vae o lē na te aumaia tala e lelei ia te i latou, o lē na te tala’i le filemu; o lē na te aumaia tala e lelei ia te i latou e lelei, o le na te tala’i le faaolataga; o lē e fai atu ia Siona: Ua nofotupu lou Atua!

verses.en: And then shall a cry go forth: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch not that which is unclean; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean that bear the vessels of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma ona alu atu ai lea o se alaga: Ia outou o ese ia, o ese ia outou, ia outou o atu i fafo mai lena mea, aua le pa’i atu i mea ua le mamā; ia outou o ese atu mai totonu o ia; ia mamā outou o e tauaveina ipu a le Alii.

verses.en: For ye shall not go out with haste nor go by flight; for the Lord will go before you, and the God of Israel shall be your rearward.
verses.sm: Ona o le a outou le o ese atu i fafo ma le faanatinati pe i le faasulusulu; ona o le a muaau le Alii ia te outou, ma o le a muliau le Atua o Isaraelu ia te outou.

verses.en: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently; he shall be exalted and extolled and be very high.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le a alo ma le poto lau auauna; o le a faaeaina ma faamaualugaina o ia ma o le a matua maualuga lava.

verses.en: As many were astonished at thee—his visage was so marred, more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—
verses.sm: E pei ona toatele sa ofo ia te oe— o ona fofoga sa faaleagaina, e sili atu i soo se tagata, ma lona tino e sili atu i lo atalii o tagata—

verses.en: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him, for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.sm: O le a faapea lava ona ia sausauina atunuu e tele; o le a tapunia e tupu o latou gutu ia te ia, ona o le a latou vaai i mea sa lei ta’uina atu ia te i latou; ma o le a latou manatunatu i mea sa latou lei faalogo i ai.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, all these things shall surely come, even as the Father hath commanded me. Then shall this covenant which the Father hath covenanted with his people be fulfilled; and then shall Jerusalem be inhabited again with my people, and it shall be the land of their inheritance.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o nei mea uma o le a mautinoa ona oo mai, e pei lava ona poloaiina ai a’u e le Tamā. Ona faataunuu ai lea o le feagaiga lea na osiafeagaiga ai le Tamā ma ona tagata; ma ona toe ’ainā ai lea o Ierusalema i o’u tagata, ma o le a avea ma laueleele o lo latou tofi.

w.en: and then shall again be inhabited
